description: Multi-turn agent eval: create a simple restaurant website from an uploaded misformatted menu, initialize git, then commit each requested improvement.

prompts.text: Create a simple static website for a restaurant called Juniper & Rye in this empty project. Use git for the project: initialize the repository if it is not already a git repo. Use the attached chaotic-menu.txt as the source for a clean menu page; normalize the formatting into readable menu sections instead of copying the messy text. Add a simple home page that lists these contact details: 42 Cedar Lane, Portland, OR; hello@juniper-rye.example; (503) 555-0198. The home page must link to the menu page. Keep it plain HTML/CSS with no package manager dependencies. Commit the finished initial site with a clear git commit message.

prompts: Improve the site with a warm visual design: add responsive CSS, pleasant colors, and shared navigation between the home and menu pages. Commit this improvement.
Add an About or Story section to the home page that mentions the chef and local seasonal ingredients. Commit this improvement.
Add opening hours and a reservations/contact call-to-action to the home page. Commit this improvement.
